notes.title: Laser Chess game Deflection is out now providing a fun new strategy game
notes.notes:
Take down the enemy King with a great big laser, that's the aim of the game in Deflection. It's basically the original Laser Chess updated for modern platforms by Coreffect Interactive.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2021/09/laser-chess-game-deflection-is-out-now-providing-a-fun-new-strategy-game

notes.title: Chess with lasers, Deflection confirmed for release on September 14
notes.notes:
Developed by the two-person studio Coreffect Interactive, the strategy game Deflection is set to release with native Linux support on September 14.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2021/08/chess-with-lasers-deflection-confirmed-for-release-on-september-14

notes.title: Chess with lasers? That's sort-of what you'll get with DEFLECTION
notes.notes:
Always on the look out for the next fun strategy game to sink some time into, I came across DEFLECTION and it looks pretty much like a game of Chess with a whole lot of lasers.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2021/02/chess-with-lasers-thats-sort-of-what-youll-get-with-deflection
